name: docgrad
description: A single-plugin marketplace: docgrad — grades a repo's documentation system as an AI agent's context source and converges it round by round.

plugins.name: docgrad
plugins.description: Documentation system grading and convergence: measure (OK/WATCH/FAIL signals, including entry-file token cost) plus judge (LLM star ratings), and a loop that fixes docs round by round until every measure signal meets its target.
